name: pipedrive
description: Pipedrive CRM integration — search deals, people, organizations, and leads; list and update deals across pipelines and stages; look up contact details; and log notes and activities. Authenticates with your personal Pipedrive API token sent as the x-api-token header against https://{companyDomain}.pipedrive.com (v2 endpoints for deals, persons, activities, and search; v1 for notes).
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Pipedrive CRM — deals, contacts, notes, and activities

fields.label: Company Domain
fields.patternMessage: Just the subdomain — e.g. 'yourcompany' for https://yourcompany.pipedrive.com
fields.helpText: The subdomain of your Pipedrive URL (https://<subdomain>.pipedrive.com). Enter only the subdomain.

fields.label: API Token
fields.helpText: Your personal API token from Pipedrive Settings > Personal preferences > API. Company admins can disable API access per user.

tools.name: pipedrive.search
tools.description: Search Pipedrive deals, people, organizations, and leads by term.

item_types.description: Comma-separated item types to search (default: deal,person,organization,lead)

tools.name: pipedrive.list_deals
tools.description: List deals, optionally filtered by pipeline, stage, status, or owner. Uses cursor pagination — pass the returned next_cursor to fetch the next page.

owner_id.description: Only deals owned by this user

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_cursor

tools.name: pipedrive.get_deal
tools.description: Get a deal's details: title, value and currency, stage, status, owner, linked person and organization, and expected close date.

tools.name: pipedrive.get_person
tools.description: Get a person's details: name, email addresses, phone numbers, and linked organization.

tools.name: pipedrive.update_deal
tools.description: Update a deal — move it to another stage, change its status (open/won/lost), or change its value or owner.

stage_id.description: Move the deal to this stage

value.description: New monetary value of the deal

owner_id.description: Reassign the deal to this user

tools.name: pipedrive.add_note
tools.description: Add a note to a deal, person, or organization.

deal_id.description: Attach the note to this deal

person_id.description: Attach the note to this person

org_id.description: Attach the note to this organization

tools.name: pipedrive.create_activity
tools.description: Create an activity (call, meeting, task, deadline, email, or lunch) with a due date, optionally linked to a deal or person.

deal_id.description: Link the activity to this deal

person_id.description: Link the activity to this person
